method: Compared each provisional atomic statement and its source scope against all 226 canonical requirement statements, source references, domains and version applicability.
Compared each provisional atomic statement against all 61 GT/FORMAT candidate statements, including Number=A/R/G/local-allele, phase-set, likelihood, base-modification and genotype semantics.
Classified exact/subsumed matches separately from partial topical relationships; similarity or shared field names alone were not treated as duplicates.
Merged duplicate provisional records created by repeated source clauses and consolidated repeated ID constraints with both source locators preserved.
Retained unresolved source ambiguity records as open review items; no author interpretation is treated as independent approval.
limitations: This is author-level semantic reconciliation, not independent standards approval.
A 'no direct duplicate identified' result does not prove that no equivalent requirement exists in unreviewed VCFv4.1–4.4 or VCFv4.0 source material.
Canonical VCFv4.0 applicability remains source-not-pinned; this pass is strictly a VCFv4.5 source review.
No canonical requirement IDs were allocated and the canonical 226-record ledger was not modified.
